title: Record the margin between two expansion axes and the chirp input cap
body:
## Summary
- A single expansion axis bounded by `3/4` exceeds the chirp input cap of `3/5`.
- The product of two such bounds is `9/16`, and `3/5 - 9/16 = 3/80` exactly.
- All 270,000 grid sums with both factors below `3/4` and an error of `0`, `1/80`, or `2/80` stay strictly below `3/5`. The selected κ is unchanged.
